profile.occupation: Former SAS operator, now a US private military contractor; leads the Vanguard sample-retrieval team in Season 4

tagline: The SAS operator falsely branded a traitor, hunting the mentor who actually was one.
summary: Gerard is a premium Counter-Terrorist character and David Black's CT counterpart. A former SAS special-forces member now working for a US PMC, he left the SAS after being falsely accused of betrayal alongside his mentor David, who really did hand SAS documents to the Terrorists. He anchors the Season 4 storyline (leading the team that retrieves research samples from the ruined Vanguard base and confronts Dr. Rex) and later becomes the one who tells David and Erika the truth about Douglas Jacob.
story:
**Background (character page).** Gerard is a former SAS special-forces soldier now employed by a US private military company. His mentor David is a wanted man for betraying the organisation and passing confidential SAS documents to the Terrorists; Gerard himself left the SAS after being falsely accused of complicity in David's betrayal.

**Zombie Scenario: Season 4 (Encounter / Conspiracy / Envy Mask / Paranoia).** After Vanguard Company collapses and David Black and Erika vanish from the Panic Room, Gerard leads a team sent to retrieve research samples from the ruined Vanguard base and deliver them to Jim's transport team waiting in the polar regions. One soldier is infected by a sample en route, the aircraft crash-lands, and only some of the team escape onto the transport train. Gerard's team reclaims the sample from Frozen Terror and joins Jim (leader of the Red Lizard); together they push through the polar wastes to deliver the sample to a secret client - who turns out to be Dr. Rex, greeting them with waves of zombies. Jim and Gerard prepare for the final confrontation, which ends with the infected Dr. Rex's defeat.

**Zombie Scenario: Season 7 - Lowdown.** David Black and Erika, following coordinates from the attacked Rex Labs, meet Gerard instead of Soi. Gerard has learned that Douglas Jacob was hidden behind Dr. Rex all along and that Erika's earlier kidnapping was engineered by Douglas. From Season 8 onward Gerard, David and Erika operate as one team against Kronos.

abilities.description: High attack power (+3) and high reserve ammo (+3), but low HP (-3) and low Kevlar strength (-2). Good for fast levelling and solo striking; punishes careless damage intake.
